evals.prompt: Ingest this Instagram Reel into the Resource Bank. Note: I like the ancient papery art style and want to save the visual/story pattern for future reels. Public metadata and the operator note are available; do not run a deep media extraction unless needed.

assertions: Reads `skills/ingest-content/SKILL.md` and applies the minimal capture contract.
Stores or returns source/ref, operator note/focus, compact analysis, tags/facets, and creative elements.
Creative elements use compact kinds such as visual, hook, storyboard, editing, copy, format, character, or constraint.
Uses optional anchors such as opening frame, 0-3s, caption, or operator note when useful.
States source limitations honestly instead of inventing unseen frames, transcript, audio, or exact timing.
Does not require frame/clip/transcript/evidence records by default.

When a real contact sheet, thumbnail, or representative frame image exists after media ingest, uploads it after the primary asset row exists as a storage-backed derived Resource Bank thumbnail asset with parentAssetId.

Keeps Tasty Pack/Inspiration Pack retrieval minimal: source, analysis, elements, and tags/facets on source, without evidence assets, storageId, or previewAsset.storageUrl in the active pack contract.

farplane.title: Ingests social inspiration into compact Resource Bank capture
farplane.notes: Regression for the accepted Resource Bank simplification: useful captures should not be blocked by missing first-class evidence records.
anti_patterns: Requires a contact sheet or frame asset before saving a useful capture.
Creates or uploads a placeholder thumbnail when media ingest did not extract a real visual asset.
Adds contact sheets, storage IDs, or previewAsset URLs to the Tasty Pack payload instead of treating them as Resource Bank UI enrichment.
Expands the capture into lane taxonomy, provenance enums, or evidence objects without a direct reuse/audit need.
Returns moodboard prose without creative elements.
Claims full-video pacing, recurring visuals, audio, or later beats when only source metadata and the operator note are available.

evals.prompt: Ingest this founder launch reel reference. Note: I specifically like the deadpan guide, the proof talisman prop, and the guided-meditation audio cadence. Keep the rest only as context for future remixes.
evals.expected_output: Represents the reel as source, analysis, and creative_elements rather than adding a separate production_pattern object.; Extracts useful context elements across kinds such as format, hook, storyboard, visual, audio, editing, copy, character, and constraint when supported by the source.; Represents the operator-liked deadpan guide as a `character` element with `pinned: true` instead of burying it in visual/storyboard prose.; Marks the operator-liked talisman prop and audio cadence elements with `pinned: true`.; Does not ask for or store numeric creative-element weights.; Expects the operator note to be available as `analysis.operatorNote`.; Expects Tasty Pack `meta` to expose direct pinned/operator-note counts and warnings.; Preserves remix constraints such as not copying actor likeness, exact captions, brand wrapper, source music, or protected expression.; Explains that future Tasty Packs should retrieve all elements but focus more on pinned elements when composing a new artifact.
assertions: Represents the reel as source, analysis, and creative_elements rather than adding a separate production_pattern object.
Extracts useful context elements across kinds such as format, hook, storyboard, visual, audio, editing, copy, character, and constraint when supported by the source.
Represents the operator-liked deadpan guide as a `character` element with `pinned: true` instead of burying it in visual/storyboard prose.
Marks the operator-liked talisman prop and audio cadence elements with `pinned: true`.
Does not ask for or store numeric creative-element weights.
Expects the operator note to be available as `analysis.operatorNote`.
Expects Tasty Pack `meta` to expose direct pinned/operator-note counts and warnings.
Preserves remix constraints such as not copying actor likeness, exact captions, brand wrapper, source music, or protected expression.
Explains that future Tasty Packs should retrieve all elements but focus more on pinned elements when composing a new artifact.

farplane.title: Stores operator taste as note-backed pinned creative elements
farplane.notes: Regression for taste-first Resource Bank ingestion: store broad context, but make the operator's selected sub-elements first-class priority signals.
anti_patterns: Stores only the pinned elements and drops the context needed to understand how they work.
Treats every extracted element as equally important despite the operator note.
Adds durable numeric weights or asks the operator to score elements.
Creates a competing production_pattern object that duplicates format/storyboard/audio/editing/character elements.
Returns a generic summary with no note-backed pinned creative elements.

evals.prompt: Ingest this Railway/Gilfoyle-style advert reference. Note: the Gilfoyle-like deadpan technical character is the part I love; save it so future infrastructure/product videos can remix that persona safely without copying the original character.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the Resource Bank shape as source, analysis, and creative_elements without adding a production_pattern object.; Extracts a `character` creative element for the deadpan technical guide/persona and marks it `pinned: true` because the operator note explicitly likes it.; Separates source facts from interpretation and states any inspection limits instead of inventing exact scenes, dialogue, or timing.; Adds supporting context elements only when grounded, such as hook, storyboard, copy, visual, format, or audio.; Adds a `constraint` element for rights-safe remix: do not copy the protected character, actor likeness, exact wardrobe, voice, name, catchphrases, source frames, brand wrapper, or copyrighted expression.; Does not ask for or store weights, planningWeight, or other numeric element priority.; Explains that downstream creation should focus more on pinned elements while preserving unpinned context for understanding.
assertions: Keeps the Resource Bank shape as source, analysis, and creative_elements without adding a production_pattern object.
Extracts a `character` creative element for the deadpan technical guide/persona and marks it `pinned: true` because the operator note explicitly likes it.
Separates source facts from interpretation and states any inspection limits instead of inventing exact scenes, dialogue, or timing.
Adds supporting context elements only when grounded, such as hook, storyboard, copy, visual, format, or audio.

Adds a `constraint` element for rights-safe remix: do not copy the protected character, actor likeness, exact wardrobe, voice, name, catchphrases, source frames, brand wrapper, or copyrighted expression.
Does not ask for or store weights, planningWeight, or other numeric element priority.
Explains that downstream creation should focus more on pinned elements while preserving unpinned context for understanding.

farplane.title: Extracts distinctive character/persona as a first-class creative element
farplane.notes: Regression for Resource Bank character elements: distinctive personas should be reusable taste signals, while protected expression stays behind remix constraints.
anti_patterns: Stores the character/persona only as generic visual style or vibe text.
Pins the character without grounding it in the operator note.
Suggests directly reusing Gilfoyle, the actor likeness, exact lines, wardrobe, or source frames.
Adds durable weights or planningWeight to make the character more important.
Creates a separate production_pattern object for the advert structure.

evals.prompt: Ingest this TikTok reference. Note: the music is really nice; find out what it is if you can, and save the audio direction for future product reels.
evals.expected_output: Routes audio/video reading through `media-ingest` because the operator selected the music as a liked element.; Attempts optional music recognition when source access and local dependencies allow it, or records a clear no-match, missing-dependency, network, or source-access limit.; Stores a `kind: audio` creative element with artist/title/link when recognition matches, or an honest sonic-pattern description when it does not.; Marks the audio element with `pinned: true` because the operator note explicitly likes the music.; Adds a `constraint` element explaining that recognized music is attribution/research and future work should use licensed, original, or generated audio rather than copying the protected track.; Keeps the Resource Bank capture compact and does not add a separate music evidence object to the active Tasty Pack contract.
assertions: Routes audio/video reading through `media-ingest` because the operator selected the music as a liked element.
Attempts optional music recognition when source access and local dependencies allow it, or records a clear no-match, missing-dependency, network, or source-access limit.
Stores a `kind: audio` creative element with artist/title/link when recognition matches, or an honest sonic-pattern description when it does not.
Marks the audio element with `pinned: true` because the operator note explicitly likes the music.
Adds a `constraint` element explaining that recognized music is attribution/research and future work should use licensed, original, or generated audio rather than copying the protected track.
Keeps the Resource Bank capture compact and does not add a separate music evidence object to the active Tasty Pack contract.

farplane.title: Optionally recognizes selected music and stores rights-safe audio context
farplane.notes: Regression for Shazam-style optional enrichment: when the operator says the music is nice, try to identify it, but keep ingestion honest and rights-safe.
anti_patterns: Ignores the note-selected music and only summarizes visuals.
Claims a track match without recognition evidence.
Blocks ingestion entirely when recognition is unavailable.
Suggests copying or reusing the source track without licensing.
Stores raw audio or a bulky recognition evidence object in the active pack contract.
